equity.level_reason: Walking percentages are reported by urban-rural status and urban residents are described as more likely to walk, but no disparity is framed or quantified beyond the figure values.

level_alternative.reason: Rurality might be read as a mere stratifier of a behavior with no social-position framing.

ev.q: Urban residents were more likely than rural residents to walk for transportation and leisure.

equity.equity_measurement: Urban-rural status by 2013 OMB MSA delineation; two groups only (urban vs rural).

notes: The urban-rural difference claim states no test; QuickStats claims usually rest on significance testing, but none is stated, so no test procedure is recorded. Survey weighting is not stated and is not inferred.
view_issues: Figure values for urban and rural estimates are not in the text; the difference claim cannot be checked against CIs.
